tagline: SoundCraft on a Selkies web desktop, a multitrack audio workstation whose sound plays in the browser.
description: SoundCraft, multitrack audio recording and mixing in the spirit of Pro Tools, on a Selkies web desktop. It runs in your browser without a VNC client or a local install, on amd64 and arm64.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: SoundCraft
